payload.recallText:
Hi our family was raised in Providence Rhode Island and all our life we were obsessed with one thing the Kennedys. They were our and whatever they were we were. If we were Catholic they were Catholic. We love them. I remember when we went to my grandma's house for Thanksgiving After dinner there was a family fight and on our Way home the radio was Talking about the JFK assassination and my sister Mycala started crying. My dad pulled to the road and told her " There's nothing you should be embarrassed about". 
In the 70s we used to head to my Aunt Pat in the summer and the Kennedy house would be across the water from her house. All the adults would put suntan in the boiling heat and position themselves not facing the water but facing the Kennedy compound. They would then gossip about the Kennedys. They would say stuff like " Oh there's Ethel walking Rose again" or " How old do you think Rose is now? When Jack died in 63 Rose was 64 and her birthday was two weeks ago"
